# TrioTag

> TrioTag connects advertisers with out-of-home (OOH), digital (DOOH), and audio (AOOH) retail advertising spaces — affordable, hyper-local, and measurable campaigns across the Philippines.

TrioTag (tinystickyads.com) is a retail media marketplace. Retailers list ad spaces (print stickers, in-store screens, audio loops, media trucks); brands and advertisers book and run campaigns; print partners fulfill physical materials.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Platform overview for advertisers, retailers, and print partners.
- [Explore Ad Spaces](/advertiser/explore): Browse available retail ad inventory by city and area.
- [List Your Space](/list-space): Onboarding for retailers to monetize their physical, digital, and audio surfaces.
- [Services](/services): Overview of advertising formats and managed services.
- [Insights](/insights): Articles on retail media, OOH advertising, and campaign strategy.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the TrioTag team.

## Solutions

- [OOH Print](/solutions/ooh): Sticker and print placements in retail venues.
- [DOOH Screens](/solutions/dooh): Digital screen advertising in stores.
- [AOOH Audio](/solutions/aooh): In-store audio jingles and voice-over spots.
- [Media Truck](/solutions/media-truck): Mobile billboard campaigns.
